result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the bottom navigation area appears too close to the system gesture bar, which partially obscures the center controls and makes the nav look misaligned/truncated.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is visually crowded by the system gesture indicator, which overlaps the center of the nav area and makes the middle icons difficult to see or tap.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area padding/margin at the bottom so the app navigation sits fully above the system gesture bar and all icons remain clearly visible.
